title: Fix bugs in a text statistics module (small, one file)
command:
Users reported bugs in textstats.py. Fix all of them without changing function names or signatures:
1. words(text): a word is a maximal run of Unicode letters or digits, optionally joined by a single ASCII apostrophe or hyphen between two such runs ("don't", "state-of-the-art", "3-2" are one word each). Non-ASCII words such as "café" and "안녕하세요" must be found. Underscores are not part of words.
2. word_count(text) must equal len(words(text)); multiple spaces, tabs and newlines must not create extra words, and empty or whitespace-only text is 0.
3. top_words(text, n=3) must be case-insensitive and return lowercase (word, count) tuples, most frequent first, ties ordered alphabetically; n <= 0 returns [].
4. sentence_count(text): '.', '!' and '?' end a sentence, and a run of them ("...", "?!") counts once; trailing text without end punctuation is a sentence too; a sentence needs at least one non-space character besides the end punctuation, so empty, whitespace-only or punctuation-only text (\"  ...  \") is 0.
5. reading_time_seconds(text, wpm=200) returns an int, rounded up (0 for no words), and raises ValueError when wpm <= 0.
